control_name: The financial mart reconciles to the consolidated fact
detail: every income statement measure, every month, recomputed from fact_financials rather than read back from the mart. Business consequence: every report downstream is built on this mart, so a difference here is a difference in everything

control_name: Every consolidated period reaches the mart
detail: iterated from the fact's periods, so a month the mart failed to build fails here rather than being absent from the results

control_name: The balance sheet mart reproduces the consolidated statement and balances
detail: the mart adds prior month and prior year to the approved statement and must change nothing else

control_name: The cash flow mart reproduces the statement and still ties
detail: adding liquidity and year-to-date columns must not disturb the tie

control_name: Closing cash agrees between the cash flow and balance sheet marts
detail: the single number every reader checks first, held in two marts

control_name: The monthly mart holds its declared grain
detail: a duplicated grain row doubles a measure and every subtotal above it still foots

control_name: The measure mart holds its declared grain
Every declared measure is populated
detail: iterated from the measure dimension, so a measure the mart failed to build fails rather than quietly disappearing from the workbook

control_name: Every stored subtotal equals its components
detail: subtotals are stored rather than left to the workbook, because a subtotal computed in a spreadsheet is a definition living in a spreadsheet

control_name: Year to date and full year are the sums of their months
detail: and the year to date restarts each fiscal year, which is the part that is easy to get wrong and impossible to see in a total

control_name: No reserved scenario is exposed as a reporting option
detail: the Downside case is architecture that has not been populated. Offering it would hand a reader an empty report that looks like a real one

control_name: Every offered version carries data
detail: iterated from the options a report offers, so an option with nothing behind it fails

control_name: Each scenario has exactly one default version
detail: three forecasts are retained and only the current one is the default. A superseded forecast presented as the forecast is a reporting error nobody would notice

control_name: Every plan version covers a complete fiscal year
detail: a budget missing a month understates the full year and every variance against it

control_name: No management adjustment reaches the statutory mart
detail: the bases are selected from the layer architecture upstream and carried onto every mart row, so a report cannot pick the wrong one by filtering wrongly

control_name: The two bases differ by layer 4 and by nothing else
detail: layer 4 is empty on the approved register, so the two bases are identical and the control says so rather than letting a table of zeros look like a proof

control_name: Excluding intercompany accounts is a no-op on Actual
detail: the comparability rule removes intercompany accounts from both sides of every comparison so that a consolidated actual can be compared with a plan that was never consolidated. On Actual the consolidation has already netted them, and this proves it -- so the rule changes the plan side only

control_name: Plan intercompany trade exists and is excluded from the measures
detail: if the plan carried no intercompany rows the exclusion would be untested and the rule would look like it worked

control_name: Plan measures above EBIT are marked comparable
detail: plan carries no consolidation entries, so a budget variance is like for like down to EBIT and is not below it. The flag says which rather than leaving a reader to discover it

control_name: Every variance is the base less the comparator
Favourability is account-aware, not sign-aware
detail: revenue above plan is favourable; operating expense above plan is not. Colouring every positive variance green says the opposite in half the statement

control_name: Both favourability directions actually occur
detail: a rule that only ever produces one answer has not been exercised, and a control over it has not been tested

control_name: Every declared comparison is populated
detail: Actual vs Budget, vs Forecast, vs Prior Year and Forecast vs Budget, iterated from the comparison dimension

control_name: Business unit totals reconcile to the measure mart
Entity totals reconcile to the measure mart
detail: the elimination entities are excluded from the entity view and included in the group, which is why this compares like with like rather than against the group

control_name: At each year end the rolling window equals the approved bridge
detail: the mart chooses the window and never the definition. Using a fiscal-year EBITDA for a year in progress divides a full net debt balance by a part-year result, which reported a covenant breach at August 2026 that does not exist

control_name: No leverage is reported on an incomplete window
detail: the first eleven months of the dataset cannot support a twelve-month measure, and a ratio computed on a partial year is worse than no ratio

control_name: No covenant measure is null
detail: a null covenant metric is not a small number, it is no number at all, and this is the measure a lender tests leverage on

control_name: The leverage limit steps down as the agreement requires
detail: 6.00x, 5.50x, 5.00x then 4.50x, each read from its own credit agreement term rather than written into the mart

control_name: Headroom is the limit less the ratio
The headcount mart reproduces the headcount fact
Headcount is continuous month to month and moves with net hiring
measured: continuity 0.0 FTE, 0 months moving against net hires
detail: each month's opening FTE is the prior month's closing at the finest grain. Hires and leavers are headcount counts and are reported beside FTE rather than netted into it, because a part-time joiner is one hire and a fraction of an FTE

control_name: Every capital project row carries a project and a translated amount
The debt roll-forward closes for every instrument and month
The FX mart's translation adjustment is the engine's
detail: constant currency is an operating measure and CTA is an equity reserve. The mart carries both, in separate columns, and never treats one as the other

control_name: Constant currency equals reported for the presentation currency
detail: every constant-currency rule must give the same answer at a rate of one; any difference is a defect in the rule itself
